title: Chapter 1389
text:
"… You found us a temporary ally in the deeper secondary dimensions and even obtained information about the World Tree's sphere of influence?"

In the meeting room of the three Universal Civilizations, Marbruce, Louis, and the Ethereal Pope could not help but widen their eyes when they heard Han Xiao's notification.

"If it weren't for Harrison, I definitely wouldn't have gone over. Then, I wouldn't have encountered such a good thing."

Han Xiao shrugged. After leaving behind the throne in the Realmless King's dimension, he returned to the main material universe and informed the three Universal Civilizations immediately, explaining the cause and effect.

Considering the Realmless King's attitude, Han Xiao only hid the information about the Pivotal Snake Egg. Before this trump card matured, there was no need to inform the three Universal Civilizations to prevent any complications.

After hearing the reason, the three of them looked at each other in surprise and joy.

Marbruce cleared his throat and said with a deep voice, "Thank you for your hard work. This is an important discovery of the expedition plan. Our next search operation will be more targeted. We have agreed to this alliance. We will send some special envoys to contact the Realmless King and discuss the future cooperation."

Although Han Xiao did not report it beforehand and made the decision on behalf of the three Universal Civilizations, this was a special period. As long as it was useful for the battle, this was a small matter.

Han Xiao nodded and took out a list of secondary dimension coordinates. "These are the secondary dimension coordinates that the Realmless King lent us as a transit outpost. We can build a new portal here and turn this area into a 'shallow layer'. You know what to do after that. Just show your gangster side, but don't push the Realmless King too hard."

"What are you saying …"

Marbruce's face twitched. He helplessly took the list and showed it to the other two leaders.

"Alright, that's all I want to say. If there's no other problem, I'll go back and take charge of the training." Han Xiao waved his hand.

"Wait, there's something else I want to discuss with you …"

This time, Louis stopped Han Xiao with a rare smile on his face, and he slowly said,

"The Beyond Grade As have sacrificed their blood and sweat for the war. After a discussion between the three parties, we have unanimously decided to set up a Soul Comfort Monument for all the Beyond Grade As who died in the war. It has nothing to do with identity, only merit."

Han Xiao's eyes flickered, and he said with relief, "It's not easy. You guys finally said something reasonable."

Louis's smile froze, and he chuckled dryly. He pretended not to hear this and asked, "Hehe, what do you think of this plan?"

"Very good, I have no objections."

Han Xiao shook his head.

During the interception of the battle, no one would be affected. At least, the Soul Comfort Monument would not let them die silently. Compared to the damage of the Internet, the Soul Comfort Monument, at least, of course, of course, the Soul's of's's,'s Soul's's. Compared to the damage of the battle of the battle of the war of the war, of the Soul of the Civilization of Their of life.

However, under the premise of the Sanctum Revival, the effect of the Soul Comfort Monument would probably be different from what they had expected. The three Universal Civilizations still did not believe that there would be no limit to the revival. In Han Xiao's opinion, the Soul Comfort Monument would probably become a 'Battle Record Ranking' that recorded the number of deaths of the various Beyond Grade As. This would deviate from his original intention … but at least it was better than nothing.

"Since you have no objections, please convey our intentions to all the association members. Let everyone know that, despite the fact that it's a transaction, we're also humane and grateful for their help. No matter what grudges we had in the past, we're still compatriots born in the same universe." The Ethereal Pope nodded.

"… Did the three of you take the wrong medicine today? Why are you speaking like that? "

Han Xiao looked at the three of them with surprise.

Marbruce said with annoyance, "Alright, that's all. Go."

Han Xiao shrugged, deactivated the remote projection, and disappeared in front of the three of them.

Seeing this, Louis relaxed, shook his head, and sighed.

"Sigh, Black Star always brings us surprises. If it weren't for him saving Harrison, we would have missed this secondary dimension intelligence."

"Black Star's luck is unbelievable. Luckily, he's our teammate now." Marbruce sighed.

The three of them sighed for a while before lowering their heads again and carefully studying the information Han Xiao had brought back.

…

It did not take much time to deal with Harrison's matter. The follow-up matters of the alliance were handed over to the three Universal Civilizations, so Han Xiao did not have to worry too much.

After returning to the training base, Han Xiao sent a message to inform them of the Soul Comfort Monument plan. Naturally, no one had any objections.

Although the original intention of the two sides joining hands was to make a deal, the Beyond Grade As did not want their contributions to be ignored. It was naturally great that the three Universal Civilizations were willing to help them increase their reputation. However, this move seemed to be maintaining their sense of belonging to the galactic society, so the Beyond Grade As were not affected.

Han Xiao checked the training of the Calamity Grades and Beyond Grade As as usual. He then went to a mental strength training room and found Fu Ding, who was training his psychic energy.

A song that directly played in the soul echoed in the room with psychic energy. Unlike pure psychic energy or mental explosion, this kind of psychic energy song was not stimulating at all. It made one immersed in it like the chirping of birds in spring, full of vitality and soothing the soul.

However, the next moment, like a calm sea, it suddenly became violent. The gentle psychic energy song suddenly became high-pitched and sharp, like country music suddenly turning into heavy metal. It wanted to tear the soul of life into pieces and throw it into the furnace to be completely destroyed. The simulated puppets in the training room had their heads blown up at the same time, falling to the ground and twitching.

Han Xiao watched from outside for a while before walking into the room. The psychic energy song immediately attacked him like a tide. The demonic sound entered his brain and made his ears ring. However, it was all blocked by his tough mental barrier and did not cause any substantial damage.

Sensing that an outsider had entered, Fuding withdrew his Psychic power and slowly opened his eyes. He smiled and teased,

He smiled and said, "Your Excellency Black Star, why are you here? Are you lacking luck again?"

"I'm here to give you some special treatment."

Han Xiao chuckled, looked at the information on the interface, and nodded.

"You're someone with talent. I can feel from your psychic energy that you've already touched the boundary of Beyond Grade A."

"It's just that I don't know how long it'll take for the final sublimation to be completed."

Fu Ding did not deny it and shook his head gently.

He had stayed in the Calamity Grade for a long time and accumulated a lot of experience. He had already touched the threshold of Beyond Grade A, but he had not taken the final step.

In the beginning, he had inherited Chen Xing's psychic skills, and now, he had walked his own path. He spent a lot of time summarizing his skills and trying to create a new path. He could feel that when his self-created path was completely formed, he would be able to enter the final sublimation and enter the Beyond Grade A.

In this regard, the Soul Swapper had helped him a lot. This Universal Treasure also had the effect of assisting him in his training, making it convenient for him to study the structure of different souls. From there, he could develop various self-created psychic attacks and perfect his own style.

Among the five major classes, other than the Esper class, the other four were groups of two. The Mage and Mechanic classes focused on erudition and needed to learn all kinds of knowledge, while the Pugilist and Psychic classes focused on pure knowledge.

Pugilists developed their physical strength and created countless martial arts schools. Psychics developed their soul and spirit, and similarly, they created many skill systems. Psychic attacks and close combat skills also had countless "force exertion techniques". The main ones were the mental, psychic, sensory, potential, and many other major branches. Under each branch, there were also various schools. Just like martial arts schools, there were hundreds of different schools.

For example, Kasuyi was most proficient in the Psychic class, while Fu Ding was proficient in the Mental class. It was rare to see Fu Ding use violent psychic energy. Most of the time, Fu Ding's psychic song was from this branch.

"Don't worry, you'll complete the transformation to Beyond Grade A very soon."

Han Xiao patted Fu Ding's shoulder. He looked at the combat information and knew that Fu Ding's Energy Rank was not far from the Beyond Grade A realm.

"I hope I can help you when the time comes …" Fu Ding sighed softly. "It's only eleven years. Even if I become a Beyond Grade A, I won't have enough time to accumulate. I'm afraid I'll only be cannon fodder on the battlefield."

"You have to have confidence in your luck. Plus, you have the Soul Swapper. No one will use your basic strength to measure your usefulness."

Han Xiao encouraged him.

Fu Ding did not have the exaggerated talent of Carrott's (Everlasting Martial Path), but he was the only one who was perfectly compatible with the Soul Swapper. The power of this perverted Universal Treasure depended on Fu Ding's own strength. Once he entered the Beyond Grade A realm, the effect of the Soul Swapper would change qualitatively. Although the souls of the World Tree experts were sucked by the mother tree and could not be completely transferred, he had specially asked Fu Ding to test it in a small-scale battle. The Soul Swapper could tear apart the souls of the World Tree members and cause heavy damage. If all the souls were pulled out, the enemy would die on the spot.

After a while, Han Xiao left the room and changed into the King suit. He teleported to a secret place in the Black Star Palace.

…

With a turn of his gaze, he arrived outside a Potential Stimulation Training Room. It was filled with all kinds of cosmic radiation and enormous pressure. Evans stood in the middle of the room, and a gentle light flowed on the surface of his body. He was using the harsh environment to train himself.

Han Xiao opened the door and walked in. The training room immediately stopped operating. Evans sensed something and turned around.

"Army Commander, what can I do for you?"

Evans nodded in greeting with a calm expression.

Han Xiao waved his hand. "There's no need to be so formal. I'm just here to see how your training is going."

As he spoke, he sized Evans up and nodded in satisfaction.

Han Xiao had been formulating an Esper Ability absorption plan for Evans. His genetic chain was very stable, and all his Esper Abilities had been carefully selected. It was enough to deal with all kinds of complex situations. Basically, none of the Esper Ability slots were wasted, and the combination of skills was countless times better than EsGod's.

At the same time, Evans had also absorbed a genetic strengthening ability that increased the speed of his Esper cultivation. Coupled with his (Top Esper Ability Affinity Physique), his growth speed was extremely gratifying. After many years of hard work, Evans had already reached the level of a high level Calamity Grade and was not too far away from Beyond Grade A.

Han Xiao injected Evans with a needle, looked at the interface, and said with a smile, "You're in the process of transforming, and it won't take long for you to complete the sublimation. I'm afraid I'll have to congratulate you in advance for becoming a Beyond Grade A. What are your plans then?"

He did not doubt Evans' talent. With (Esper Ability — Copy) and (Top Esper Ability Affinity Physique), there was almost a 100% chance that he would become a Beyond Grade A Super. It was only a matter of time.

Evans smiled and said, "If not for you, I might still be an ordinary person. You've been funding me to improve my strength for the past few decades, and I owe you too much. If you don't mind, I hope to stay in the army and repay this debt."

Han Xiao was very satisfied with this answer. To be honest, he did not really want to let this talent go.

Under his correct guidance and the precipitation of the first half of his life, Evans did not fall because of this shortcut Esper Ability. Instead, his heart became as firm as a rock, and he always made others worry less.

Furthermore, Evans had always been grateful to him for activating his suppressed talent and giving him a new life. His loyalty was probably even higher than Lothaire's.

Han Xiao pressed on Evans' shoulder, smiled, and said, "Become a Beyond Grade A as soon as possible. I'll give you a gift then."

"What gift?" Evans was curious.

"It's a secret. You'll know when the time comes."

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

When Evans became a Beyond Grade A, he would be able to absorb Esper Abilities of the same level. Gaud, who had been imprisoned in the Spacetime Amber for many years, would have a chance to use it. After many years of observation, he was sure that Evans was qualified to accept this gift.

A Super High Risk Esper Ability like Energy Control definitely could not be wasted. Letting Evans take this Esper Ability was the best way to make use of it. The Esper Ability that EsGod had spent so much effort to synthesize would become someone else's, and he would also let this evil guy have a taste of being a victim.

By then, the reaction of the three Universal Civilizations would no longer be a problem. Han Xiao planned to tell them everything about what EsGod had done. Regardless of whether the three Universal Civilizations believed him or not, they would not fall out with him when the enemy attacked.

As for EsGod's main body, the Underworld would not mind having another strong man … Before EsGod was captured, he thought that the three Universal Civilizations would release him one day to ask about the World Tree. However, from the beginning to the end, Han Xiao did not plan to let this extremely dangerous villain regain his freedom.

…

The frontline troops had always been blocking the World Tree's advance, and the three Universal Civilizations had also begun their destructive development of the periphery of the Flickering World. The galactic society was in a state of panic, and the training base was in a rare state of peace.

The changes in the battle outside did not affect their training plan for the time being. Time passed quickly during the training.

Under Han Xiao's training plan, a large number of trainees were overjoyed to feel their improvement. Other than one person, the rest of the trainees trained more diligently.

After spending a few months in training, Oathkeeper, who was far away in the Holy Covenant, finally sent a message saying that he had gathered another set of keys to the First Sanctum.

Han Xiao had been waiting for this moment. Without any delay, he informed everyone and entered the Sanctum again. Under the gazes of the Holy Covenant members, he disappeared from the main universe again.
